Initial release of dingo-data-quality.

- Provides comprehensive data quality evaluation for AI training data, SFT datasets, RAG pipelines, and OCR documents.
- Supports over 70 built-in metrics, with both rule-based (fast, free) and LLM-based (semantic, requires API key) evaluation modes.
- Includes flexible configuration for multiple data formats (JSONL, JSON, CSV, plaintext, Parquet) and sources (local, HuggingFace, S3, SQL).
- Offers both CLI and Python SDK interfaces with customizable config files.
- Outputs detailed per-item and summary reports for quality review.
